eager.en: The students were eager to see the results of the experiment.
eager.zh: 學生們很期待看到實驗結果。

economic.en: The report explains how tourism supports local economic growth.
economic.zh: 這份報告說明觀光如何支持地方經濟成長。

economy.en: A strong economy can create more job opportunities for young people.
economy.zh: 強健的經濟可以為年輕人創造更多工作機會。

edition.en: The library received the latest edition of the science textbook.
edition.zh: 圖書館收到最新版的自然科教科書。

effective.en: Regular review is an effective way to remember new vocabulary.
effective.zh: 規律複習是記住新單字的有效方法。

efficiency.en: The new system improved efficiency by reducing unnecessary paperwork.
efficiency.zh: 新系統透過減少不必要的文書作業提升效率。

elderly.en: The program provides free transportation for elderly residents in the area.
elderly.zh: 這項計畫為當地年長居民提供免費交通服務。

elect.en: Students will elect a class representative at the next meeting.
elect.zh: 學生將在下次班會選出班級代表。

election.en: The school election gave students a chance to practice democratic participation.
election.zh: 校內選舉讓學生有機會練習民主參與。

element.en: Trust is an important element of successful teamwork.
element.zh: 信任是成功團隊合作的重要要素。

eliminate.en: The new rule aims to eliminate unnecessary waste in the cafeteria.
eliminate.zh: 新規定旨在消除餐廳中不必要的浪費。

embarrass.en: The teacher avoided questions that might embarrass students in front of classmates.
embarrass.zh: 老師避免提出可能讓學生在同學面前尷尬的問題。

emergency.en: Every classroom has clear instructions for what to do in an emergency.
emergency.zh: 每間教室都有緊急情況時該怎麼做的清楚指示。

emotion.en: Music can express emotion even when no words are used.
emotion.zh: 即使沒有歌詞，音樂也能表達情感。

emphasize.en: The coach used the meeting to emphasize the importance of teamwork.
emphasize.zh: 教練利用會議強調團隊合作的重要性。

employment.en: The course teaches practical skills that may improve future employment opportunities.
employment.zh: 這門課教授可能提升未來就業機會的實用技能。

enable.en: Digital tools enable students to organize information more easily.
enable.zh: 數位工具讓學生能更容易整理資訊。

encounter.en: Travelers may encounter unexpected delays during the holiday season.
encounter.zh: 旅客在假期期間可能遇到意外延誤。

encourage.en: Teachers should encourage students to ask questions when they are confused.
encourage.zh: 老師應鼓勵學生在困惑時提出問題。

enormous.en: The project required an enormous amount of time and careful planning.
enormous.zh: 這項專題需要大量時間與仔細規劃。

ensure.en: Please check the form again to ensure that every section is complete.
ensure.zh: 請再次檢查表格，確保每個欄位都填寫完整。

entertain.en: The short performance was designed to entertain visitors during the break.
entertain.zh: 這場短演出是為了在休息時間娛樂訪客。

entrance.en: Students gathered near the main entrance before the museum opened.
entrance.zh: 博物館開門前，學生聚集在主要入口附近。

equal.en: Each group should receive an equal amount of time to present.
equal.zh: 每組都應獲得相同的報告時間。

equip.en: The school plans to equip every classroom with a new projector.
equip.zh: 學校計畫為每間教室配備新的投影機。

escape.en: The hikers followed the marked trail to escape the heavy rain.
escape.zh: 健行者沿著標示步道避開大雨。

establish.en: The club hopes to establish a regular reading program this semester.
establish.zh: 社團希望這學期建立固定的閱讀計畫。

estimate.en: Scientists estimate that the repair will take several months.
estimate.zh: 科學家估計修復工作需要數個月。

ethical.en: The class discussed ethical questions about the use of artificial intelligence.
ethical.zh: 全班討論了人工智慧使用上的倫理問題。

evaluate.en: Students learned how to evaluate online information before using it in reports.
evaluate.zh: 學生學會在報告中使用網路資訊前先評估其可靠性。

eventually.en: After several attempts, the team eventually found a solution.
eventually.zh: 經過幾次嘗試後，團隊終於找到解決方法。

evidence.en: Strong evidence is necessary to support a scientific conclusion.
evidence.zh: 有力證據是支持科學結論所必需的。

exact.en: Please record the exact time when the reaction begins.
exact.zh: 請記錄反應開始的確切時間。

examine.en: The researchers will examine the samples under a microscope.
examine.zh: 研究人員會在顯微鏡下檢查樣本。

exchange.en: The exchange program allows students to experience another culture directly.
exchange.zh: 交換計畫讓學生能直接體驗另一種文化。

excite.en: New discoveries can excite students and make science feel more relevant.
excite.zh: 新發現能讓學生感到興奮，也讓科學更貼近生活。

exclude.en: The study did not exclude students who had limited computer experience.
exclude.zh: 這項研究沒有排除電腦經驗有限的學生。

expand.en: The city plans to expand the bicycle network next year.
expand.zh: 市政府計畫明年擴大自行車路網。

expectation.en: Clear expectations help students understand what they need to complete.
expectation.zh: 清楚的期待能幫助學生了解需要完成什麼。

expense.en: The school covered the travel expense for the competition.
expense.zh: 學校負擔了比賽的交通費用。

expert.en: An expert visited the class to explain renewable energy technology.
expert.zh: 一位專家到班上說明再生能源技術。

expose.en: The activity can expose students to ideas from different cultures.
expose.zh: 這項活動能讓學生接觸來自不同文化的觀點。

external.en: The device connects to an external monitor for a larger display.
external.zh: 這個裝置可連接外接螢幕以顯示更大的畫面。

facility.en: The new sports facility includes a gym and an indoor court.
facility.zh: 新的運動設施包含健身房與室內球場。

factor.en: Sleep is an important factor in students' ability to concentrate.
factor.zh: 睡眠是影響學生專注能力的重要因素。

failure.en: Failure can provide useful information about how to improve a design.
failure.zh: 失敗可以提供如何改進設計的有用資訊。

familiar.en: The song sounded familiar even though I could not remember its title.
familiar.zh: 這首歌聽起來很熟悉，但我想不起歌名。

famous.en: The museum displays works by several famous local artists.
famous.zh: 博物館展示數位知名在地藝術家的作品。

feature.en: One useful feature of the app is its offline dictionary.
feature.zh: 這個應用程式的一項實用功能是離線字典。

female.en: The study included an equal number of male and female participants.
female.zh: 這項研究包含相同人數的男性與女性參與者。

finance.en: The course introduces basic ideas about personal finance and saving.
finance.zh: 這門課介紹個人理財與儲蓄的基本概念。

financial.en: The family created a financial plan before making the large purchase.
financial.zh: 這個家庭在進行大筆消費前先制定財務計畫。

focus.en: Please focus on the main idea instead of every small detail.
focus.zh: 請專注於主要概念，而不是每個小細節。

formal.en: Students wore formal clothes for the graduation ceremony.
formal.zh: 學生穿著正式服裝參加畢業典禮。

former.en: A former student returned to share advice about university life.
former.zh: 一位校友回來分享大學生活的建議。

fortune.en: Good preparation often matters more than fortune in an important competition.
fortune.zh: 在重要比賽中，充分準備往往比運氣更重要。

forward.en: Please move forward carefully until you reach the marked line.
forward.zh: 請小心往前移動，直到到達標示線。

foundation.en: Basic reading skills provide a strong foundation for later learning.
foundation.zh: 基本閱讀能力為後續學習建立穩固基礎。

frequently.en: This word appears frequently in news articles about technology.
frequently.zh: 這個單字經常出現在科技相關新聞中。

frighten.en: Sudden loud noises can frighten animals in the area.
frighten.zh: 突然的巨大聲響可能會嚇到附近的動物。

function.en: The teacher explained the function of each part of the machine.
function.zh: 老師說明機器每個零件的功能。

fundamental.en: Clear communication is fundamental to successful group work.
fundamental.zh: 清楚溝通是成功小組合作的基本要素。

furthermore.en: The plan saves money; furthermore, it reduces energy use.
furthermore.zh: 這項計畫能省錢；此外，也能減少能源使用。

gender.en: The survey compared study habits without making assumptions about gender.
gender.zh: 這份調查比較學習習慣，並未對性別做預設。

genetic.en: The article explains how genetic information can influence certain traits.
genetic.zh: 這篇文章說明遺傳資訊如何影響某些特徵。

genuine.en: Her genuine interest in science was clear from the questions she asked.
genuine.zh: 從她提出的問題可以看出她對科學有真誠的興趣。

guarantee.en: Careful planning cannot guarantee success, but it can reduce mistakes.
guarantee.zh: 仔細規劃無法保證成功，但能減少錯誤。

guilty.en: The court found the defendant guilty after reviewing the evidence.
guilty.zh: 法院審查證據後判定被告有罪。

headline.en: The headline summarized the main point of the news article.
headline.zh: 標題概括了這篇新聞的重點。

hesitate.en: Do not hesitate to ask the teacher when an instruction is unclear.
hesitate.zh: 如果指示不清楚，不要猶豫，請直接詢問老師。

highlight.en: Use a marker to highlight the key sentence in each paragraph.
highlight.zh: 請用螢光筆標出每段的關鍵句。

historical.en: The class visited a historical building that was over one hundred years old.
historical.zh: 全班參觀了一棟有百年以上歷史的建築。

household.en: The survey asked about average household energy use each month.
household.zh: 這份調查詢問每戶家庭每月的平均能源使用量。

however.en: The first method was faster; however, the second was more accurate.
however.zh: 第一種方法較快；然而，第二種較準確。

human.en: The exhibition explores how human activity affects the natural environment.
human.zh: 這場展覽探討人類活動如何影響自然環境。

humor.en: A little humor can make a presentation more enjoyable for the audience.
humor.zh: 一點幽默可以讓報告對觀眾來說更有趣。

hunger.en: The charity raises money to reduce hunger in low-income communities.
hunger.zh: 這個慈善組織募款以減少低收入社區的飢餓問題。

hunt.en: The students had to hunt for reliable sources before writing the report.
hunt.zh: 學生在寫報告前必須尋找可靠資料來源。

hypothesis.en: The experiment was designed to test the students' original hypothesis.
hypothesis.zh: 這項實驗是為了驗證學生原先的假設。
